name: Townshend Wall Lamp
desc: A rustic-industrial wall sconce featuring a black metal wall plate, a projecting wood-accented arm, and an exposed bulb enclosed within a geometric black wire cage. The fixture provides warm decorative accent lighting suitable for hallways, bedrooms, living spaces, and industrial or farmhouse interiors.

specifications.Arm Material: Wood-accented horizontal support with black metal brackets
specifications.Light Source: Single exposed LED or filament-style bulb
specifications.Light Distribution: Warm ambient and downward decorative illumination
specifications.Estimated Dimensions: Approx. 420 mm projection x 300 mm height
specifications.Recommended Use: Hallway / Bedroom / Living room / Entryway / Cafe / Industrial interiors
